hostels.name: A Beary Good Hostel — Bugis
hostels.summary: Our flagship backpacker hostel, steps from Bugis Street and the Kampong Glam heritage district.
writeup: Our flagship TWL Hospitality property sits in the heart of Bugis, a short walk from Kampong Glam, Haji Lane and the Bugis MRT interchange.
Dorm and private rooms are designed for independent travellers, with a shared kitchen, lounge and rooftop common area for guests to meet.

hostels.name: A Beary Good Hostel — Chinatown
hostels.summary: A conservation shophouse conversion in the heart of Chinatown, close to Maxwell Food Centre.
writeup: Housed in a restored conservation shophouse, this hostel blends heritage architecture with modern dorm and ensuite room options.
Guests are a two-minute walk from Maxwell Food Centre and the Chinatown MRT station, with easy access to the CBD.

hostels.name: A Beary Good Hostel — Lavender
hostels.summary: A quieter, budget-friendly base near Lavender MRT with easy access to the city and Kallang riverside.
writeup: Our Lavender property is a favourite with longer-stay guests, offering a calmer neighbourhood setting a few minutes from Lavender MRT.
The Kallang Riverside and city centre are both a short ride away, making it a practical base for both leisure and work travel.

hostels.name: A Beary Good Hostel — Geylang
hostels.summary: Our most affordable property, popular with long-stay guests exploring Singapore's eastern food scene.
writeup: Set along Geylang's famed food street, this property is our most budget-conscious offering and a favourite for long-stay and returning guests.
It's a short ride from Changi Airport and the eastern coastal parks, with some of Singapore's best-loved hawker fare on the doorstep.
